blurb: Captain’s Cove Adventure Golf magnificent waterfall sets the mood for what is more than a fun round or two of challenging miniature golf. It’s an escape to a beautiful nautical theme park with lovely plantings, lush green lawns, rushing streams, story book coves and winding and rolling paths.
